answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 700 fakes pays 466 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. A ember of doubt is healthy, a jade of proof is required, and a ledge of patience is the price of a clean panel.
